assertions.description: Before `flow->tcp.fingerprint_raw = ndpi_strdup(options_fp);` executes, the `options_fp` stack buffer must already denote an initialized C string. The vulnerable witness violates this obligation at the protected sink; a fixed execution may satisfy it at the sink or avoid the protected sink entirely.
The vulnerable source call site passes `options_fp` as the actual argument to `ndpi_strdup`.
The same local `options_fp` buffer allocated in the SYN fingerprint block is the buffer later consumed by the raw duplication call.
